newsitem.title: FRANCE: FRENCH STOCKS EXPECTED TO START STEADY.
newsitem.headline: FRENCH STOCKS EXPECTED TO START STEADY.

text.p: PARIS, Aug 4 (Reuter) French shares were expected to start with a steady tone, pulled downward by weaker bonds but supported by a steady dollar, traders said.
The market was likely to be thin, with the start of the August holiday lull.
* CAC-40 index closed doen 26.33, or 0.85 percent, at 3,049.44.
* CAC-40 August futures contract on GLOBEX up 11 at 3,064.
